hero.title: Silence, Machined from Solid Billet.
hero.body: Engineered around a custom 98mm ultra-thin planar magnetic transducer housed in 5-axis CNC-milled 6061-T6 aluminum and grade-5 titanium. Zero resonant plastics. Uncolored studio reference acoustics.

transition.body: Every NOIRÉ object is photographed and calibrated across two lighting environments: nocturnal studio shadow and natural architectural daylight.

manifesto.title: We reject disposable velocity. Every NOIRÉ instrument is milled from solid billet, calibrated in anechoic silence, and serialized to outlast a decade of daily physical contact.
manifesto.body: Consumer technology has grown weightless, transient, and visually noisy. NOIRÉ restores permanence to the objects you touch every hour—uniting Swiss 5-axis CNC metallurgy with Japanese acoustic and optical precision.

subtract.title: Subtract Ornament
subtract.detail: Every radius, chamfer, and aperture exists solely to serve acoustic damping, thermal dissipation, or tactile orientation.

mass.title: Honor Physical Mass
mass.detail: We reject hollow injection-molded shells. Solid billet aluminum, grade-5 titanium, and architectural brass ground each object in space.

endure.title: Engineered to Endure
endure.detail: Torx T6 assembly and modular internal architecture ensure every battery, driver, and switch remains serviceable for a decade or more.

showcase.title: Precision Hardware, Serialized by Discipline.
showcase.calibrationBody: Every switch, rotary encoder, and counterweight is force-curve tested across 10,000 actuation cycles prior to serialization.

categories.title: Six Systems of Spatial & Acoustic Order.
categories.body: Select a discipline to inspect its material parameters, machining tolerances, and active instrument allocations.

spotlight.dspBody: Continuously maps wall reflections at 192kHz to eliminate standing bass waves in any architectural volume.
spotlight.packagingBody: Illustrative flight-case concept only; no shipment, courier booking, or white-glove fulfillment service is connected.

craft.title: From 18 Kilograms of Raw Billet to an Instrument of Silence.
craft.body: True luxury in industrial hardware is measured by what is removed. When you lift a NOIRÉ object, the cold density in your palm is the result of uncompromising subtraction and acoustic discipline.
craft.cavityVerification: ACOUSTIC CAVITY VERIFICATION // ZERO STANDING INTERNAL RESONANCE
craft.doctrineTitle: Why Mass Matters in Acoustic & Tactile Hardware.
craft.doctrineBody1: Micro-vibrations are the enemy of both acoustic fidelity and tactile precision. In conventional plastic electronics, the housing vibrates sympathetically with the transducer or key switch, smearing transient detail.
craft.doctrineBody2: By machining our enclosures from solid blocks of aerospace aluminum and architectural brass, the chassis acts as an inert seismic anchor—allowing only pure sound, light, or mechanical actuation to reach your senses.

subtraction.title: 5-Axis CNC Billet Milling
subtraction.body: An 18.4-kilogram block of forged 6061-T6 aluminum spends four hours inside a 5-axis milling cell. Over 85% of the raw alloy is subtracted and recycled in-house to leave a single seamless monocoque with zero internal weld seams.
subtraction.caption: FIG 08.A — 5-AXIS MONOCOQUE TOOLPATH GEOMETRY

surface.title: Ceramic Bead-Blast & Type III Anodizing
surface.body: Before electrochemical anodization, each chassis is bombarded with fine zirconium-silicate glass beads. The resulting matte skin scatters ambient light without glare and resists skin oils and micro-abrasions for decades.
surface.caption: FIG 08.B — MICRO-CRYSTALLINE OXIDE LAYER INSPECTION

longevity.title: Anechoic Calibration & Modular Serviceability
longevity.body: Every NOIRÉ instrument is assembled solely with standardized Torx T6 titanium fasteners—never permanent adhesives. Each unit is individually swept in our Zürich anechoic chamber and shipped with its signed calibration graph.
longevity.caption: FIG 08.C — ZÜRICH ANECHOIC CHAMBER FREQUENCY SWEEP
